lead: Mohanlal is a widely followed Indian film actor, born on 21 May 1960 in Elanthoor.
As of 2026, he is 66 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has been recognised with Padma Bhushan and National Film Award for Best Actor.

sections.heading: Mohanlal — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mohanlal was born on 21 May 1960 in Elanthoor, and holds Indian nationality.
He is a sibling of Suresh Balaje.

He is recorded as speaking Hindi, Tamil, English and Malayalam.
